clue.text: African starling's quick bite concealed by high fence

indicators.note: something concealed by another thing is hidden inside it, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: an oxer is a tall show-jumping fence with a rail beyond a hedge
a peck is a quick nip with the beak or lips

explanation.surface: A starling darts a quick bite at something hidden behind a tall fence on the savanna.
explanation.walkthrough: An oxer is a show-jumping obstacle: a hedge with a rail set out in front.
explanation.definitionFit: These birds, which ride cattle picking off ticks, were long classed in the starling family and still look like close relatives.

clue.text: Possibly stroke male pigs bishop released on island

indicators.note: released means let go, so that letter is freed from the word and dropped

parts.note: boars are male pigs
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
the Isle of Man, in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: Someone may pet the hogs that a bishop has turned loose on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly stroke' reads as a verb; the stroke is the rower setting the pace nearest the stern.
explanation.definitionFit: The stroke is the crew member who sets the rhythm, so a stroke is one example of a rower.

clue.text: Choice reportedly taken by photographer?

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said out loud, so the sound counts, not the spelling

parts.note: your pick is your choice

explanation.surface: Asks whether a selection was made by someone with a camera.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the definition by description: what a photographer takes.
explanation.definitionFit: Pic is informal shorthand for a picture, and a photographer takes pictures.

clue.text: Beam, having ability to restrain opponent

indicators.note: to restrain is to hold in, so the outer word grips the inner one

parts.note: clever means able, talented
an anti is someone against something

explanation.surface: A wrestler with the skill to pin a rival is beaming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having ability' tempts the short word for being able; the whole phrase is the outer word here.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantilever is a projecting beam or girder fixed at only one end.

clue.text: Welshman protecting current source of bottled water

indicators.note: protecting something means wrapping round it to shield it

parts.note: Evan is a typical Welsh first name
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A Welshman guards the flowing stream that supplies bottled water.
explanation.definitionFit: Evian-les-Bains on Lake Geneva is the spring town whose name is on a well-known mineral water.

clue.text: Prepare to engage private music group

indicators.note: to engage someone is to take them on and hold them, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: to set something up is to prepare it
Pte is the army abbreviation for a private soldier

explanation.surface: Someone gets ready to hire a band for a private function.
explanation.walkthrough: 'private' looks like an adjective describing the group, but it is the soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A septet is an ensemble of seven musicians, so it is a kind of musical group.

clue.text: European crazy about cheese

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for European

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word is read back to front

parts.note: mad means crazy

explanation.surface: A Continental who is wild about cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Edam is the round Dutch cheese in red wax, named after its home town.

clue.text: What's-his-name's light adhesive: twelve pence once

parts.note: thin means light, slight
gum is glue
before decimalisation a bob was a shilling, which was twelve old pence, so twelve pence was a bob

explanation.surface: Somebody's flimsy glue cost a shilling in the old days.
explanation.walkthrough: A bob was British slang for a shilling, worth twelve old pence before 1971.
explanation.definitionFit: Thingumabob is a placeholder for a person or thing whose name escapes the speaker.

clue.text: One leaves Moroccan port carrying a bird

indicators.note: carrying something means holding it inside, so the word wraps around it
leaves means departs, so that letter goes away from the place name

parts.note: Tangier is the port at Morocco's northern tip
I is the Roman numeral one
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone departs a North African harbour with a bird on board.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the I from TANGIER, then put A inside what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: A tanager is a brightly coloured American songbird.

clue.text: French composer's communication on opening of rondeau

parts.note: a message is a communication

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: the first letter of rondeau

explanation.surface: A French composer sends a note about the start of his rondeau.
explanation.walkthrough: A rondeau is a French verse or song form, fitting the musical surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Andre Messager was a French composer and conductor of operettas and ballets around 1900.

clue.text: Further thought about payment for service

parts.note: re is Latin-derived for 'concerning, about'
in law and polite usage a consideration is a payment or fee in return for something done

explanation.surface: Someone thinks again about the fee they were charged for a service.
explanation.definitionFit: To reconsider is to give a matter a second, further spell of thinking.

clue.text: Shot some birds around noon? This is macabre!

definitions.note: the noun naming the quality: what 'this' is, being macabre

indicators.note: around says the rebuilt letters go on either side of the single letter
something shot to pieces is wrecked, so these letters are scattered and rebuilt

parts.note: the nine letters to be rearranged
N is the abbreviation for noon

explanation.surface: A hunter guns down birds at midday, and the onlooker finds the scene gruesome.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters of 'some birds' wrap around N for noon.
explanation.definitionFit: Morbidness is an unhealthy taste for death and gloom, which is the quality of being macabre.

clue.text: Bring up lover without hesitation, a large naval officer

parts.note: to rear children is to bring them up

indicators.note: without means lacking, so the hesitation sound is taken away from the word

parts.note: an admirer is a suitor or lover
er is the sound of hesitating
taken as written
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Instructions for raising a confident suitor, then a big officer of the fleet.
explanation.definitionFit: A rear admiral is a senior naval rank, just below vice admiral.

clue.text: Past caring ultimately, or eagerly expectant?

parts.note: ago means in the past, gone by

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word before it

parts.note: the last letter of caring

explanation.surface: A question: is someone beyond caring now, or keenly waiting for something?
explanation.definitionFit: Agog describes someone in a state of excited, impatient anticipation.

clue.text: Champion initially inventing stories, tokens of a bygone age

parts.note: a victor is a winner, a champion

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the next word

parts.note: the first letter of inventing
ana is a collection of anecdotes or sayings about a person

explanation.surface: A winner first makes up tales about relics of the past.
explanation.walkthrough: Ana, a collection of anecdotes, is a crossword regular for 'stories'.
explanation.definitionFit: Victoriana are objects and ornaments surviving from the Victorian era, keepsakes of a past time.

clue.text: Regularly enter an exam: that's most clever

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter is taken

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters of these words
a test is an examination

explanation.surface: Sitting exams routinely is the smartest thing to do, says some advice.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat can mean cleverly done or ingenious, so the superlative is the most clever.

clue.text: Head round city with this writer's place name study

parts.note: the head of something is its top
O is round in shape
NY is New York
this writer refers to the setter, so 'this writer's' is my

explanation.surface: The setter tours a city on a study of place names.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this writer' is the setter, so the possessive 'this writer's' gives MY.
explanation.definitionFit: Toponymy is the scholarly study of place names and their origins.

clue.text: More ghastly ingrained dirt by river across motorway

indicators.note: lying across something means stretching over it, so the outer letters span the single one

parts.note: grime is dirt worked into a surface
R is the abbreviation for river
M is the prefix on British motorway numbers, as in the M1

explanation.surface: A filthy scene where a river runs alongside a motorway gets even nastier.
explanation.walkthrough: GRIME and R join first, and the M sits inside that string.
explanation.definitionFit: Grim means harsh or forbidding, so grimmer is more ghastly in the sense of more dreadful.

clue.text: Panic about start of real Brussels outburst

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the outer word goes round what follows

parts.note: to be in a flap is to be in a panic

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: the first letter of real
Brussels is the seat of the European Union, so it stands for the EU

explanation.surface: Alarm over a genuine row in Brussels erupts into a political outburst.
explanation.definitionFit: A flare-up is a sudden burst of anger or violence, a synonym for an outburst.

clue.text: Particular person originally from American location

indicators.note: originally means at the start, so the first letter is taken

parts.note: the first letter of from
US for United States
a spot is a place or location

explanation.surface: A specific individual who comes from a place in America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Particular' looks like 'specific' but here means fussy.
explanation.definitionFit: A fusspot is someone fastidious, hard to please, which is the sense of particular as choosy.

clue.text: Estimable person painting piece of furniture

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword staple for an artist
a table is an item of furniture

explanation.surface: An admirable artist is at work painting a piece of furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Estimable' looks like praise, but here it means able to be estimated or valued.
explanation.definitionFit: Ratable means capable of being rated or assessed, which is what estimable literally says.

clue.text: Endless report of revolution in east Alabama

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the pair of letters that follow

parts.note: E for east
AL is the postal code for Alabama

indicators.note: a report of something is what is heard of it, so a word that sounds the same is needed

parts.note: a turn is one revolution

explanation.surface: News of an uprising that never ends in eastern Alabama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolution' suggests a rebellion; here it is a single turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternal means lasting forever, without any end.

clue.text: Quite a problem for listeners!

indicators.note: for listeners means the word is to be judged by its sound when spoken

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: An exclamation that something is really tricky for an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quite a' works in phrases like 'that was some party', where some means remarkable.
explanation.definitionFit: Used emphatically, 'some' before a noun means a remarkable one, exactly as 'quite a' does.

clue.text: Responsible news broadcast received in farming land

indicators.note: something received in a place is taken into it, so it sits inside

parts.note: arable land is ploughed for crops

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, as seed is, so the letters are strewn into a new order

parts.note: the four letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A dutiful farmer listens to the news bulletin out in the fields.
explanation.definitionFit: To be answerable for something is to be accountable or responsible for it.

clue.text: Crank heading for Western Isle

indicators.note: the heading of a word is its first letter

parts.note: the first letter of Western
inch is a Scottish word for a small island

explanation.surface: An eccentric sets off for an island in the Western Isles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crank' looks like an oddball, but it is the handle. An inch is a small island in Scotland, as in Inchcolm.
explanation.definitionFit: A winch is a hoist worked by turning a handle, so it is a crank in the mechanical sense.

clue.text: Function popular when visiting the Kent area

indicators.note: someone visiting an area is inside it, so the word sits within the other

parts.note: Kent is a county in south-east England, so its area is SE
something in is fashionable, popular

explanation.surface: A social function goes down well when held around Kent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Function' looks like a party; it is the trigonometric sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Sine is a trigonometric function, the ratio of opposite side to hypotenuse.

clue.text: Irishman visiting close relative, heretical legislator

indicators.note: someone visiting is inside another's home, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a parent is a close relation
Liam is a common Irish first name
Arianism was the heresy denying Christ's full divinity

explanation.surface: An Irish lawmaker with unorthodox views drops in on his mother or father.
explanation.definitionFit: A parliamentarian is a member of a parliament, a body that makes laws.

clue.text: One charged over breaking in

indicators.note: breaking into something means getting inside it, so the letter enters the word

parts.note: taken as written
O is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A burglar accused of breaking and entering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One charged' suggests a defendant; it is a particle with an electrical charge.
explanation.definitionFit: An ion is an atom or molecule that carries an electric charge.

clue.text: Farmer that may be used to steer?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: one who tills, working the soil

definitions.text: that may be used to steer
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the bar attached to a boat's rudder

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a farmer steering cattle, but the second sense is nautical.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an agent noun for someone cultivating land and the lever that turns a rudder.

clue.text: Bomb fragments ruined her plans

indicators.note: something ruined is wrecked, so these letters are broken up and rebuilt

parts.note: the eight letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: An explosion wrecked everything she had been planning.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrapnel is the metal splinters thrown out when a shell or bomb bursts.
